title: Cottage in the Valley - A Suite Stay for Two
description:
Fully remodeled with a full kitchen & laundry our cottage is perfect for your Nashville retreat!  Enjoy the spacious walk-in shower with rainfall showerhead, a queen Casper mattress, and the softest linens. AT&T Fiber  included with free Netflix as well as a PlayStation & games! We're on a quiet street and convenient 15 minute access to downtown, Vanderbilt, Lipscomb, BNA airport, and many natural areas. 10 minutes from the Nashville Zoo and 2 blocks from Ellington Agriculture's hikes and parks.

The space
Completely remodeled, 15 minutes from the Nashville scene, you will find a well-equipped kitchen, laundry, and entertainment area. You are also welcome to use the side yard and firepit during your stay.

Guest access
Backyard directly off guesthouse, and one reserved parking space in the driveway with additional parking on the street.

Other things to note
Please note the 15-20 minute travel time to many major sites in Nashville so that you can plan accordingly and know prior to booking. This is a great space in an awesome neighborhood and well worth those few extra minutes.  15-18 minutes is a typical commute for most Nashville locals.
